Definition: from G4253 and G2675; to prepare in advance:--make up beforehand.
BiblicalUsage: Prokatartizo means to prepare in advance, to make up beforehand. Paul uses it once, asking the brethren to make up beforehand the Corinthians' bounty, that it may be ready as a matter of bounty and not of covetousness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe generosity prepared in advance is generosity without pressure, and readiness is itself a gift.
